name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo 2.2

tables.definition: One row for each hospital admission; contains admission, discharge, demographic and administrative information.

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Identifier for the patient; the same patient may have multiple hospital admissions.

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Unique identifier for a hospital admission.

columns.name: admittime
columns.definition: Date and time the patient was admitted to hospital.

columns.name: dischtime
columns.definition: Date and time the patient was discharged from hospital.

columns.name: deathtime
columns.definition: Time of in-hospital death, when applicable.

columns.name: admission_type
columns.definition: Category describing urgency or type of admission.

columns.name: admit_provider_id
columns.definition: Deidentified identifier of the provider admitting the patient.

columns.name: admission_location
columns.definition: Location or source from which the patient was admitted.

columns.name: discharge_location
columns.definition: Disposition or location to which the patient was discharged.

columns.name: insurance
columns.definition: Insurance category recorded for the hospital admission.

columns.name: language
columns.definition: Patient language recorded for the hospital admission.

columns.name: marital_status
columns.definition: Marital status recorded for the hospital admission.

columns.name: race
columns.definition: Patient race category recorded for the hospital admission.

columns.name: edregtime
columns.definition: Date and time of registration in the emergency department.

columns.name: edouttime
columns.definition: Date and time of departure from the emergency department.

columns.name: hospital_expire_flag
columns.definition: Binary indicator of in-hospital death for the admission.

tables.definition: Charted ICU observations including vital signs, laboratory values and clinical settings.

columns.name: subject_id
columns.definition: Patient identifier.

columns.name: hadm_id
columns.definition: Hospital-admission identifier.

columns.name: stay_id
columns.definition: ICU stay identifier.

columns.name: caregiver_id
columns.definition: Identifier of the caregiver who documented the measurement.

columns.name: charttime
columns.definition: Time at which the observation was made; usually the closest proxy to measurement time.

columns.name: storetime
columns.definition: Time at which the observation was entered or manually validated.

columns.name: itemid
columns.definition: Identifier of a measurement concept; can be resolved using d_items.

columns.name: value
columns.definition: Recorded value of the concept identified by itemid.

columns.name: valuenum
columns.definition: Numeric representation of value when numeric.

columns.name: valueuom
columns.definition: Unit of measurement for value, when applicable.

columns.name: warning
columns.definition: Whether a warning was manually documented for the observation.

note: Standardized metadata projection. Original input/data_dictionary.json remains authoritative for additional fields; no evaluator Gold included.
